newsitem.title: USA: Resource Bancshares to merge with 2 firms.
newsitem.headline: Resource Bancshares to merge with 2 firms.

text.p: Resource Bancshares Mortgage Group Inc said Friday it signed separate definitive merger pacts with Resource Bancshares Corp and Walsh Holding Co Inc.

Resource Bancshares Corp, which provides small-ticket equipment leasing services and originates and services commercial mortgage loans, owns about 38 percent of Resource Bancshares Mortgage Group's common stock.

Under their pact, to be accounted for as a purchase transaction, Resource Bancshares Mortgage will issue about two million more shares in addition to the 7.4 million shares of its stock owned by RBC, to RBC shareholders.
Walsh is a nationwide mortgage lender specializing in subprime mortgage loans. Resource said its pact with Walsh will be accounted for as a pooling-of-interests.
It said it will issue about 21.4 million shares of its common stock to Walsh shareholders of Walsh.
Shares of Resource Bancshares Mortgage closed Friday up 5/8 at 13-3/4.
